evidence: Caes. BG 3.28: magna tōtīus exercitūs perturbātiō facta est (Lewis & Short)
terms.comment: Disorder in a crowd, an army or the state; of the mind, agitation, emotion (Cic.) (Lewis & Short).

evidence: Cic. N.D. 1.3: perturbātiō et cōnfūsiō vītae (Lewis & Short)
Caes. BG 2.11: magnō cum strepitū ac tumultū (Lewis & Short)
terms.comment: Noisy disorder, a riot; in Roman law a sudden war or rising near home (Lewis & Short).

phrases.latin: magna tōtīus exercitūs perturbātiō facta est
phrases.english: there was great disorder throughout the army

phrases.latin: quid hoc hīc clāmōris, quid hoc hīc tumultī est?
phrases.english: what is all this shouting, what is all this uproar here?

sources: Lewis & Short: perturbatio · Lewis & Short: confusio · Lewis & Short: tumultus
